set -euo pipefail
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/workspace")
out=root/"p24-q80-node-factorization-20261126"/"attempt-001"
assert os.statvfs(root).f_bavail*os.statvfs(root).f_frsize>=64*1024*1024
lean=Path("/workspace/toolchains/lean-4.33.0-rc1-linux/bin/lean")
assert hashlib.sha256(lean.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="e8baaa71855a616dc351028f3ad2200051b0671f423a1696a100e809302d5550"
version=subprocess.check_output([str(lean),"--version"],text=True).strip()
assert "62eed1db4d67327ec8120be05f1a1b0847d74561" in version
data=base64.b64decode("",validate=True)
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=="2f2e00982c0e28a4e93187106df1d0eed5d0912aec2b6473c0737689ac9c2a48"
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
source=out/"Factor.lean"
source.write_bytes(data)
command=[str(lean),"-t0","-j1","-M4096","-DwarningAsError=true","-DmaxRecDepth=50000","-DmaxHeartbeats=40000000","-o",str(out/"Factor.olean"),str(source)]
env=dict(os.environ);env["LEAN_PATH"]=str(root);env["LEAN_SYSROOT"]=str(lean.parent.parent)
print(json.dumps({"diagnostic_only":True,"all_credit":False,"source_sha256":"2f2e00982c0e28a4e93187106df1d0eed5d0912aec2b6473c0737689ac9c2a48","command":command,"version":version}),flush=True)
start=time.monotonic()
result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
(out/"compile.log").write_bytes(result.stdout)
print(result.stdout.decode(errors="replace"),end="",flush=True)
assert source.read_bytes()==data
receipt={"diagnostic_only":True,"compile_credit":False,"kernel_credit":False,"acceptance_credit":False,"exit_code":result.returncode,"elapsed_seconds":elapsed,"source_sha256":"2f2e00982c0e28a4e93187106df1d0eed5d0912aec2b6473c0737689ac9c2a48","log_sha256":hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),"canonical_P2_touched":False,"existing_P1_project_touched":False}
(out/"diagnostic.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
